    global main
    extern printf

    mov rbp, rsp

    add r12, 6          ; r12 = 26

    sub r13, 6          ; r13 = 14

    ; 3. Multiplication (20 * 6 = 120)
    mov rax, 20
    imul rax, 6         ; rax = 120
    mov r14, rax

    ; 4. Division & Modulo (20 / 6 -> quotient 3, remainder 2)
    mov rax, 20
    cqo                 ; Sign-extend rax into rdx:rax
    mov rbx, 6
    idiv rbx            ; rax = quotient (3), rdx = remainder (2)
    mov r15, rax        ; r15 = 3 (division)
    mov rbx, rdx        ; rbx = 2 (modulo)

    mov rdi, fmt
    mov rsi, r12
    mov rdx, r13
    mov rcx, r14
    mov r8, r15
    mov r9, rbx
    xor eax, eax
    call printf

    leave
